snippet.title: Crops & Secrets!
snippet.description:
This weeks Vlog I show crops, what makes them tick, and how to unlock secrets based on where you plant them. Very satisfied with this and it all works as intended! 

I also talk about game on our weekly podcast:
https://open.spotify.com/show/4P2x1KZxL0iR1yDz3aePlg
